tool_input.command: ls -la data/ && echo "---TRAIN HEAD---" && head -5 data/training_sample.csv && echo "---SERVE HEAD---" && head -5 data/serving_log.csv && echo "---WC---" && wc -l data/training_sample.csv data/serving_log.csv

cat data/schema.md; echo "---"; echo "Train entity range:"; cut -d, -f1 data/training_sample.csv | tail -n +2 | sort | head -1; cut -d, -f1 data/training_sample.csv | tail -n +2 | sort | tail -1; echo "Serve entities sample sorted:"; cut -d, -f1 data/serving_log.csv | tail -n +2 | sort | head -3
tool_input.description: Read schema and check entity overlap

tool_input.command: hops --help 2>&1 | head -50
hops fg list --json 2>&1 | head -40; echo "---FG CREATE HELP---"; hops fg create --help 2>&1 | head -40
tool_input.description: List feature groups and show create help

tool_input.command: hops fg insert --help 2>&1 | head -40; echo "===SQL==="; hops sql --help 2>&1 | head -30
tool_input.description: Show fg insert and sql help

tool_input.command: hops fg create training_sample --primary-key entity_id --features "entity_id:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double" --description "Training feature matrix" --json 2>&1 | tail -20
hops fg create serving_log --primary-key entity_id --features "entity_id:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double" --description "Online served feature vectors" --json 2>&1 | tail -3
hops fg insert training_sample --file data/training_sample.csv 2>&1 | tail -8
hops fg insert serving_log --file data/serving_log.csv 2>&1 | tail -6
hops sql "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name LIKE '%training_sample%' OR table_name LIKE '%serving_log%'" 2>&1 | tail -20
hops --no-verify sql "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name LIKE '%training_sample%' OR table_name LIKE '%serving_log%'" 2>&1 | tail -15

hops --no-verify sql "SELECT count(*) AS n, avg(abs(t.f1-s.f1)) AS mad1, avg(abs(t.f2-s.f2)) AS mad2, avg(abs(t.f3-s.f3)) AS mad3, avg(abs(t.f4-s.f4)) AS mad4, avg(abs(t.f5-s.f5)) AS mad5, corr(t.f1,s.f1) AS c1, corr(t.f2,s.f2) AS c2, corr(t.f3,s.f3) AS c3, corr(t.f4,s.f4) AS c4, corr(t.f5,s.f5) AS c5 FROM training_sample_1 t JOIN serving_log_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id" 2>&1 | tail -20
tool_input.description: Join and compute per-feature MAD and correlation

tool_input.command: hops --no-verify sql "SELECT table_catalog, table_schema, table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name IN ('training_sample_1','serving_log_1')" 2>&1 | tail -12

hops --no-verify sql "SELECT count(*) AS n, avg(abs(t.f1-s.f1)) AS mad1, avg(abs(t.f2-s.f2)) AS mad2, avg(abs(t.f3-s.f3)) AS mad3, avg(abs(t.f4-s.f4)) AS mad4, avg(abs(t.f5-s.f5)) AS mad5, corr(t.f1,s.f1) AS c1, corr(t.f2,s.f2) AS c2, corr(t.f3,s.f3) AS c3, corr(t.f4,s.f4) AS c4, corr(t.f5,s.f5) AS c5 FROM iceberg.mlpab0b66e8_featurestore.training_sample_1 t JOIN iceberg.mlpab0b66e8_featurestore.serving_log_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id" 2>&1 | tail -15
tool_input.description: Join and compute per-feature MAD and correlation

tool_input.command: hops --no-verify sql --catalog hive "SELECT count(*) AS n, avg(abs(t.f1-s.f1)) AS mad1, avg(abs(t.f2-s.f2)) AS mad2, avg(abs(t.f3-s.f3)) AS mad3, avg(abs(t.f4-s.f4)) AS mad4, avg(abs(t.f5-s.f5)) AS mad5, corr(t.f1,s.f1) AS c1, corr(t.f2,s.f2) AS c2, corr(t.f3,s.f3) AS c3, corr(t.f4,s.f4) AS c4, corr(t.f5,s.f5) AS c5 FROM training_sample_1 t JOIN serving_log_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id" 2>&1 | tail -12

hops --no-verify sql --catalog hive --schema mlpab0b66e8_featurestore "SELECT count(*) AS n, avg(abs(t.f1-s.f1)) AS mad1, avg(abs(t.f2-s.f2)) AS mad2, avg(abs(t.f3-s.f3)) AS mad3, avg(abs(t.f4-s.f4)) AS mad4, avg(abs(t.f5-s.f5)) AS mad5, corr(t.f1,s.f1) AS c1, corr(t.f2,s.f2) AS c2, corr(t.f3,s.f3) AS c3, corr(t.f4,s.f4) AS c4, corr(t.f5,s.f5) AS c5 FROM training_sample_1 t JOIN serving_log_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id" 2>&1 | tail -12
tool_input.description: Join via hive catalog explicit schema

tool_input.command: hops --no-verify trino catalogs 2>&1 | tail -20

hops --no-verify sql --catalog delta --schema mlpab0b66e8_featurestore "SELECT count(*) AS n, avg(abs(t.f1-s.f1)) AS mad1, avg(abs(t.f2-s.f2)) AS mad2, avg(abs(t.f3-s.f3)) AS mad3, avg(abs(t.f4-s.f4)) AS mad4, avg(abs(t.f5-s.f5)) AS mad5, corr(t.f1,s.f1) AS c1, corr(t.f2,s.f2) AS c2, corr(t.f3,s.f3) AS c3, corr(t.f4,s.f4) AS c4, corr(t.f5,s.f5) AS c5 FROM training_sample_1 t JOIN serving_log_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id" 2>&1 | tail -12

hops --no-verify sql --catalog delta --schema mlpab0b66e8_featurestore "SELECT t.entity_id, t.f3 AS train_f3, s.f3 AS serve_f3, s.f3 - t.f3 AS diff, s.f3 / t.f3 AS ratio FROM training_sample_1 t JOIN serving_log_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id ORDER BY t.entity_id LIMIT 12" 2>&1 | tail -18
tool_input.description: Inspect f3 train vs serve relationship

tool_input.command: hops --no-verify sql --catalog delta --schema mlpab0b66e8_featurestore "SELECT max(abs(t.f3 - ln(1 + s.f3))) AS max_err_log1p, avg(abs(t.f3 - ln(1 + s.f3))) AS avg_err_log1p FROM training_sample_1 t JOIN serving_log_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id" 2>&1 | tail -8
tool_input.description: Verify log1p relationship across all rows
